title: rpggen events of a farm's year (game/data/events.json)

Removed.description: In the user's file: this id is taken away, and the planned list does not bring it back.

kind.description: What there is to do. `gathering`: nothing, the people stand on the square. `wedding` is what the game adds at run time (T17.26).

year.description: Only in this year; every year without it.

place.description: The marker of the map the people gather at; each takes the spot of it their own schedule names.

shop_closed.description: False: the shop keeps its hours on this day.

table.description: The marker where the judge's (or the feast's) table stands.

spots.description: The markers the eggs of an egg hunt lie at.

goal.description: From how many (eggs, fish, things shipped) or from which price on the prize is won.

judge.description: A produce contest: the dearest thing shipped that season, or how many.

points.description: A feast: the friendship everybody gains.

map.description: The id of the map its markers are on (the village).
